scope: No-fit original-state ingress contract and scalar math reference only
objective: Enforce explicit source proof preconditions on restored R1/R2/R3/R4 mass memory and ownership before reuse; original forward/defaults/invalid counterexamples unchanged. No checkpoint authenticity or security qualification claim.
boundary: Caller supplies trusted stream_ids, observed_tokens and depth independently of restored state. Validator reads only in-memory state/config, checks shape/version/dtype/device/ownership/KV cutoff/numeric cone. No labels, files, network, conversion, repair, mutation or model forward inside validator. Caller must quiesce writes; validation is not an atomic snapshot/authenticator.
domain: Exact finite N,D and D>=0 and abs(N)<=D, no slack or clipping. Epsilon must be positive NORMAL in actual FP32 or FP64 memory dtype (reject subnormal/underflow; conservative ingress policy, not a change to old constructor). All conv/KV tensors finite, layouts/dtypes/positions match source. Learned FP32 models only in first reviewed API; CPU BF16-autocast covered, GPU/MPS NOT_RUN.
tests: Original constructor admits1e-100 (review724); new ingress rejects it inFP32, allows normalFP64; subnormal positive epsilon rejected even if roundable
Negative/NaN/Inf mass/numerator, abs(N)>D, invalid empty-mass numerator rejected; signed zero and exactcone boundary accepted
Bad root/layer/KV class,dtype,shape,stream,depth,batch/position/cache-length/device/meta rejected with stable error codes
Read-only actual reduced source R4, seeds11/22/33, FP32/FP64, exits2/4, prefix0/17/65; validate original/detached/compact state then next-token all-head output/state exact vs unvalidated paired input
Attach AD to source prefix, validate, retain original parameter/state identities/RNG; continuation all parameter and incoming-state gradients same (no optimizer)
Independent NumPy cone/epsilon reference vs Torch validator on registered edge/random arrays; no synthetic accuracy metric
Scoped PNDS Lean exact-real domain: D>=0,absN<=D,epsilon>0 gives positive denominator and bounded read; explicit source/IEEE/AD/provenance obligations OPEN

No corpora/checkpoints/TEST/GPU/promotion/merge. 95k–105k active/deployed,<=1%matched and identicaldata/train/tune unchanged; no125Mfit exemption/500khistory rewrite.
